rule_format: Like the app's Rule (shared/types.ts): scope lists core ppd: terms per field (a missing field means any), effect allow or dont_allow; 'condition' on an allow rule is a PPD qualifier the compiler sends as constraints (protocol-04 7.11-7.12); origin kind 'preset' or 'answer'. A preset's rules never overlap.
